pages.title: AP reports first human H5N1 death — Palnadu child

facts.text: Who: two-year-old girl from Palnadu district
facts.head: News

facts.text: Died: 16 March at AIIMS-Mangalagiri (multi-organ failure; also had leptospirosis)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Confirmed: 31 March by NIV, Pune
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Second human H5N1 death in India; first in AP
facts.head: News

facts.text: Likely source: habit of eating raw chicken; Palnadu had no prior bird flu outbreak
facts.head: News

facts.text: Response: RRTs from Guntur GGH; contacts tested negative
facts.head: News

facts.text: H5N1 = highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI); human-to-human transmission unconfirmed
facts.head: Background

pages.title: Displaced Gutti Koya tribals — call for permanent settlement

facts.text: Who: Gutti Koya (Gond) tribals displaced from Chhattisgarh by anti-Maoist operations (Strategic Hamlet Programme, since 2005) — living on forest lands in AP and Telangana ~2 decades
facts.head: Issue

facts.text: Numbers: Telangana 24,000, AP 8,000 — treated as migrants, not STs
facts.head: Issue

facts.text: ⚠ ST in Chhattisgarh but not ST in AP/Telangana
facts.head: Issue

facts.text: Strategic hamleting: ~50,000 Gonds moved to roadside camps; strategy borrowed from US war in Vietnam; earlier used in Mizoram (1960s)
facts.head: Issue

facts.text: FRA 2006, Section 3.1(m): tribals displaced before cut-off 13 December 2005 entitled to alternative forest land
facts.head: Law

facts.text: No national IDP policy; contrast Bru Rehabilitation Plan, 2019 (Bru settled in Tripura)
facts.head: Law

facts.text: NCST ordered surveys; suggested alignment with UN Guiding Principles on Internal Displacement
facts.head: Law

pages.title: 25% RTE quota in AP private schools from 2025–26

facts.text: What: Section 12(1)(c) of RTE Act, 2009 — 25% of Class 1 seats in private unaided schools for disadvantaged/EWS children, from 2025–26
facts.head: News

facts.text: Applications: 28 April – 15 May, via School Education Dept website; also at Village Secretariat, MRC
facts.head: News

facts.text: Age: 5 years completed by 31 March (IB/CBSE/ICSE) or by 1 June (State syllabus)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Free and compulsory education for ages 6–14; implements Article 21-A
facts.head: Background — RTE Act

facts.text: No detention till Class 8; no capitation fees; School Management Committees
facts.head: Background — RTE Act
